hebrewText: דַּבֵּ֨ר וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֜ כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֗ה הִנְ/נִ֤י עָלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ פַּרְעֹ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם הַ/תַּנִּים֙ הַ/גָּד֔וֹל הָ/רֹבֵ֖ץ בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ יְאֹרָ֑י/ו אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָמַ֛ר לִ֥/י יְאֹרִ֖/י וַ/אֲנִ֥י עֲשִׂיתִֽ/נִי

tokens.bdb: perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue
tokens.kjv: answer, appoint, bid, command, commune, declare, destroy, give, name, promise, pronounce, rehearse, say, speak, be spokesman, subdue, talk, teach, tell, think, use (entreaties), utter, [idiom] well, [idiom] work.

tokens.bdb: {YHWH}
tokens.kjv: God.

tokens.bdb: lo!; also (as expressing surprise) if
tokens.kjv: behold, if, lo, though.

tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.

tokens.bdb: Paroh, a general title of Egyptian kings
tokens.kjv: Pharaoh.

tokens.bdb: a king
tokens.kjv: king, royal.

tokens.bdb: Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt
tokens.kjv: Egypt, Egyptians, Mizraim.

tokens.bdb: a marine or land monster, i.e. sea-serpent or jackal
tokens.kjv: dragon, sea-monster, serpent, whale.

tokens.bdb: great (in any sense); hence, older; also insolent
tokens.kjv: [phrase] aloud, elder(-est), [phrase] exceeding(-ly), [phrase] far, (man of) great (man, matter, thing,-er,-ness), high, long, loud, mighty, more, much, noble, proud thing, [idiom] sore, ([idiom]) very.

tokens.bdb: to crouch (on all four legs folded, like a recumbent animal); be implication, to recline, repose, brood, lurk, imbed
tokens.kjv: crouch (down), fall down, make a fold, lay, (cause to, make to) lie (down), make to rest, sit.

tokens.bdb: a channel, e.g. a fosse, canal, shaft; specifically the Nile, as the one river of Egypt, including its collateral trenches; also the Tigris, as the main river of Assyria
tokens.kjv: brook, flood, river, stream.

tokens.bdb: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
tokens.kjv: [idiom] after, [idiom] alike, as (soon as), because, [idiom] every, for, [phrase] forasmuch, [phrase] from whence, [phrase] how(-soever), [idiom] if, (so) that ((thing) which, wherein), [idiom] though, [phrase] until, [phrase] whatsoever, when, where ([phrase] -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, [phrase] whither(-soever), who(-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.
